candidates.rationale: Fresh Supreme Court action changes yesterday's live election-operations uncertainty.
Fresh election-record development complements but does not duplicate the mail-ballot ruling.
Fresh market setup for Wednesday's Fed decision and mortgage-yield reaction.
Fresh official Columbus development with workforce, downtown, and real-estate implications.
Fresh rate-pressure story paired with NAR inventory data creates a different workflow takeaway from prior rate recaps.
Fresh wealth-advisor AI deployment row with named custodian distribution.
Fresh AP report advances the U.S.-China frontier story with model rankings and contested distillation allegations.
Fresh market color used compactly, not a major story.

stories.new_fact: The Supreme Court rejected the administration's request to stay lower-court blocks on the Postal Service mail-ballot plan.
stories.new_takeaway: Election offices move from legal suspense to voter-communication cleanup under existing state mail-voting systems.
stories.why_now: The order landed late Monday while mail voting is already underway in some states.
stories.previous_coverage: September 12 and September 14 covered injunction timing; this is a Supreme Court action with a different takeaway.
stories.uncertainty: Future merits litigation and any narrowed federal election rule remain unresolved.
stories.watch: Whether state election offices issue revised voter guidance after the Supreme Court action.

stories.new_fact: A whistleblower disclosure said DHS's Unlawful Voter Initiative had employees checking state voter systems after less than two hours of training and reviewing up to 40 people per day.
stories.new_takeaway: The election-administration risk also includes federal handling of state voter records, not only the Postal Service mail-ballot rule.
stories.why_now: The AP report and congressional disclosure were published today.
stories.previous_coverage: No prior episode in the seven-script comparison covered this DHS voter-check project.
stories.uncertainty: DHS disputes the criticism and has not stopped the effort as of the cutoff.
stories.watch: Whether DHS pauses the project, states sue, or Congress obtains training and data-quality records.

stories.new_fact: Ohio State announced Moritz College of Law will move to 17 S. High St. under a 30-year lease, with an expected fall 2029 opening.
stories.new_takeaway: The move is a downtown workforce and institutional-foot-traffic bet, not merely a campus facilities change.
stories.why_now: Ohio State announced the move Monday afternoon.
stories.previous_coverage: No prior episode in the seven-script comparison covered this project.
stories.uncertainty: Renovation details, public incentives, and the future of Drinko Hall remain to be clarified.
stories.watch: Renovation scope, lease and incentive details, and employer partnerships before the fall 2029 opening.

stories.new_fact: Rates are closing in on or above 7 percent while NAR's August data show existing sales down 2 percent and inventory at 1.62 million homes.
stories.new_takeaway: Lenders should refresh active preapprovals and concession math before borrowers negotiate from stale payments.
stories.why_now: The WSJ published the 7 percent housing-market pressure story today.
stories.previous_coverage: Recent episodes covered lock desks, VantageScore, and servicing convexity; this uses inventory and sales weakness to change active-purchase workflow.
stories.uncertainty: A Fed message that calms long yields could quickly change daily pricing.
stories.watch: Whether lenders refresh preapprovals and whether post-Fed daily pricing stays above 7 percent.

stories.new_fact: Schwab Advisor Services is the first RIA custodian included in Anthropic's Claude for Financial Advisors, according to Schwab and Barron's.
stories.new_takeaway: Advisor copilots should be evaluated around data entitlement, human review, and client-communication evidence, not demo writing quality.
stories.why_now: The Schwab/Anthropic announcement and reporting were published Monday.
stories.previous_coverage: Recent banking AI episodes covered support agents, financial crimes, and research copilots; this rotates to wealth/advisor workflow.
stories.uncertainty: No measured productivity, compliance, or client-outcome baseline was disclosed.
stories.watch: Whether Schwab or an advisory firm discloses rollout scope, review controls, or measured advisor outcomes.
stories.ledger_row_changed: Added Schwab / Anthropic, lane 5 wealth and advisor copilot, status announced, evidence customer disclosure plus reporting, metric none disclosed.

stories.new_fact: AP reported China is narrowing the U.S. AI capability lead and cited third-party rankings plus U.S. agency allegations of targeted distillation.
stories.new_takeaway: Export controls may slow hardware access without fully preventing capability diffusion, so evaluation and model-security evidence become more important.
stories.why_now: AP published the model-competition report today ahead of the expected Trump-Xi meeting.
stories.previous_coverage: September 14 covered China's diplomatic response to Anthropic; this adds specific model competition and contested distillation evidence.
stories.uncertainty: The distillation allegation is contested and model rankings shift quickly.
stories.watch: Whether the September 24 meeting produces evaluator access, export-control changes, or model-security commitments.
stories.frontier_bar: Benchmark or evaluation plus infrastructure and policy pressure.

stories.new_fact: Global shares traded lower after AI stocks slid, oil rose, and investors looked to a likely Fed rate hike Wednesday.
stories.new_takeaway: The bond-market reaction matters more for borrowers than the headline equity move.
stories.why_now: The market setup is live before Wednesday's Fed decision.
stories.previous_coverage: Recent episodes covered Fed and oil pressure; this is kept compact.
stories.uncertainty: The Fed hike is expected but not guaranteed.
stories.watch: Whether the Fed message calms or lifts long yields.

stories.new_fact: NWS forecast calls for sun and a high near 88 Tuesday, then storm chances late Wednesday and Thursday.
stories.new_takeaway: Tuesday is the better outdoor window before hotter and less stable weather returns.
stories.uncertainty: Storm timing and local rainfall will update through Wednesday.
stories.watch: Recheck radar before Wednesday evening practices or commutes.
